question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "had taken."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The reason to use **"had taken"** in the blank is to convey a past action that occurred before another past event.
 
• The past perfect tense,** "had taken,"** indicates that Harry took his place between Ron and Hermione before a point in the past when something else happened.
 
• This construction is useful when you want to express the sequence of events in the past.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct paragraph:

Professor Sprout was standing behind__ a trestle bench in the centre of the greenhouse. __About__ twenty __pairs__ of different-coloured ear muffs __were__ lying on the bench. Harry __**had taken**__ his place between Ron and Hermione.
